inp:Transport C 1 Notes:
1) Specify Transport details.

a) For all Declaration Types, specify inward transport, except
for the following:
i) goods released from licensed premises such as Licensed
Warehouse, Excise Factory, Zero-GST Warehouse, Bonded
Warehouse
ii) declaration type = BKT (Blanket)
iii) declaration type = SHO
iv) for goods previously exempted/suspended from duties/taxes
v) supplementary declaration for schemes under AISS, IGDS
such as place of receipt = AISSLOC, SPIGDS

movement):
i) Specify Inward transport.

ii) Specify Outward transport (if goods are not meant for
storage).

c) For declaration type = REX, specify:
i) Inward transport.

for storage with valid place of storage as FTZ.
